idea-plugin.name: ACH / NACHA Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
ACH / NACHA Toolkit — validate and generate US ACH files in the IDE

Payments engineers hand-craft and debug fixed-width NACHA ACH files (94-character records, batch and file control totals, entry hash) and today paste them into random websites or eyeball them by hand — exactly the data that should never leave your machine. This tool window does it offline: no browser, no upload, no telemetry.

  • Validate — paste or open an ACH file and get a precise problem list: wrong record length, bad ABA routing check digit on an entry, and mismatched entry hash, total debit / credit, entry count or block count in the batch/file control.
  • Generate — produce a spec-valid single-batch PPD sample file (correct control totals and entry hash) and a deliberately invalid variant for negative tests, then copy it.
  • Routing numbers — the ABA routing-transit check digit (weights 3-7-1, mod 10) is the same check real Federal Reserve routing numbers pass; generate valid ones or verify your own.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ ACH / NACHA. Fully offline and deterministic — the same validated engine behind the Kassi fintech tools.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Pick the Standard Entry Class for generated samples: PPD, CCD, WEB or TEL. The SEC code is written into the batch-header record and the file still validates.

1.1.0

  • Addenda records (type 7): generated sample files now carry a payment-related addenda (type code 05) on an entry — with the entry's addenda indicator set and the batch/file entry+addenda counts updated — and validation recognises type-7 records, checks their addenda type code, and includes them in the control-total count.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: a tool window to validate a NACHA ACH file (record length, ABA routing check digits, entry hash, batch/file control totals, block count) and to generate a spec-valid PPD sample file plus a deliberately-invalid variant. Offline and deterministic.
